title: Jazzy Egyptian Bean Sprouts Bowl
description: A crispy, spice‑laden bowl brimming with roasted bean sprouts and sun‑kissed tomatoes, perfect for a quick meal‑prep Egyptian feast.
instructions: Soak 1 cup dried mung beans in water for 8 hours or overnight.
Rinse the beans, drain, and spread them in a thin layer on a baking sheet.
Let the beans sprout at room temperature for 2 days or until they reach 1 inch tall.
Preheat the air fryer to 200°C (400°F) and lightly spray with cooking spray.
Place the sprouted beans in the air fryer basket, toss with 1 tbsp olive oil, and air fry for 10 minutes, shaking halfway, until crisp.
Meanwhile, heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté diced onion until translucent.
Add cherry tomatoes, cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, black pepper, and cayenne, cooking until tomatoes soften and spices bloom.
Remove the skillet from heat, stir in 2 tbsp lemon juice, and season with salt to taste.
Assemble bowls by adding a generous portion of the roasted bean sprouts, topping with the spiced tomato mixture and a drizzle of tahini.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve warm or at room temperature.
